stem:
Use “Good Enough” and “Simply Me” to answer the following question.

BOTH the story “Good Enough” and the poem “Simply Me” develop the idea that —

options.label: A
options.text: people should be kinder to themselves

options.label: B
options.text: people should not try so hard to succeed

options.label: C
options.text: forgiving others can provide great healing

options.label: D
options.text: encouragement from others is vital to well-being
